A '''laserdrill''', also called a '''laser drill''', '''beam laser''', or '''drilling laser''', was a tool. [[Prisoner/Legends|Prisoners]] at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Kalist Base|Kalist VI labor colony]] had access to [[Laser/Legends|laser]] drills.
